title: Hallelujah
hook: The one chord in *Hallelujah* that isn't in the key
cover_text: The one chord that *isn't in the key*

chords.name: G
chords.text: *G*, the V. You expect C next…

chords.name: Am
chords.text: …but it lands on *A minor*. A deceptive cadence.

chords.name: E7
chords.text: *E7*: its *G♯* isn't in C. It leans into A.

chords.name: Am
chords.text: And it resolves to *A minor*. The sad ending feels inevitable.
